provisionalCapture.quote: Create a small editable tabletop scanning rig. Use a circular turntable 70 cm across with its top 24 cm above the floor, and an overhead rectangular light panel centered over it, supported by a freestanding frame with two posts and a crossbeam. Leave exactly 32 cm clear between the turntable top and the underside of the light panel so bulky samples can be inserted. Keep that sample-loading space usable as we develop the rig. Add a separate 40 cm storage cube two meters to the left. Keep the parts separate and choose sensible dimensions for the frame.
